data.pipeline: authors' clean pipeline: download_dataset.sh, run_mfa.sh, prepare_dataset.sh clean
data.audio_features: facebook/wav2vec2-base-960h, mean of the last 4 hidden layers
data.train_stories: story 0 sounds 0-3, story 1 sounds 0-5, story 2 sounds 0-7, story 3 sounds 0-4
data.test_sounds: story 3 sounds 5-11; never used for training in any session
data.scaling: authors' per-recording RobustScaler + StandardScaler fitted on the recording before its first test sound; unlabeled, but uses the target recording itself

training.model: 2 temporal blocks, 25 branches, 3D spatial attention (authors' selected model)
training.row_filtering: Only the authors' df_train27.csv / df_test27.csv rows are filtered (by subject and session); MEG arrays, audio embeddings, model and trainer are unchanged.
training.untrained_slots: Subject-layer slots of excluded subjects receive zero gradient (AdamW, weight decay 0) and stay at initialisation.

evaluation.bank: all 1005 test audio windows, the same for every condition

metrics.top10: true window in the first ten
metrics.top1_tol1: first candidate is the true window or its 1-s neighbour in the same sound file (auxiliary)
metrics.rank: 0-based rank of the true window among 1005

evaluation.aggregation: per window -> per subject (all evaluated rows of that subject in the condition) -> mean over seeds within subject -> statistics across subjects
evaluation.statistics: mean and 95% t-interval across subjects; paired Wilcoxon signed-rank across subjects, Holm correction within each experiment

exp08_reproduction.purpose: Reproduce the authors' selected model; ceiling for exp08 and the own-W_s reference for exp09.
exp08_reproduction.acceptance: final-test Top-10 within the authors' range (70.0-70.9%, seeds 42-44: 70.598, 70.387, 70.003); a deviation of more than 2 p.p. stops the series for investigation

exp08_cross_session.purpose: Does a subject's W_s learned in one session work in the other session without any training?
exp08_cross_session.train_rows: all subjects that have the train session, train sounds of that session only

conditions.own_same: own slot, test sounds of the train session (reference, no session change)
conditions.own_cross: own slot, test sounds of the target session (main result)
conditions.mean_cross: mean of the trained slots of all other subjects, target session
conditions.other_cross: each other trained subject's slot in turn, target session; averaged over donors
conditions.ceiling: exp08_reproduction model, own slot, target session test sounds

exp08_cross_session.interpretation: In MEG-MASC both sessions contain the same stories, so in direction A the target session is a second listening. Comparing the drop in A and B separates the session change from stimulus familiarity on the listener's side.

exp09_new_subjects.purpose: Zero-shot transfer to subjects absent from training using the mean subject matrix.
exp09_new_subjects.train_rows: all sessions of the 24 subjects outside the fold
exp09_new_subjects.evaluated_rows: test sounds of every session of the held-out subjects

conditions.mean_norm: the same mean, rescaled to the average Frobenius norm of the 24 trained slots (rule fixed in advance from the exp06 diagnosis; no data of the new subject)
conditions.untrained: the held-out subject's own, never-trained slot (sanity check, expected near chance)
conditions.own_seen: exp08_reproduction seed 42, the subject's own trained slot (reference: the subject was in training)

deviation.reason: Shortened from 9 to 6 folds (18 held-out subjects) to obtain results sooner. Decided before any exp09 result was seen. Folds 6-8 remain defined and can be run later as confirmation.

execution_record.actual_preprocessing: raw without ICA; NEMAR nm000229 v1.0.1, confirmed by user; original planned clean pipeline above retained as historical protocol
execution_record.rank_check_deviation: Original >=99% identical ranks was relaxed to >=95% identical, >=99.9% within two positions, Top-10 absolute difference <=0.002. Actual results in trainer_agreement.json.
execution_record.interpretation_correction: A/B session differences do not causally separate repeated listening from visit effects; training cohorts also differ (27 vs 22).
